info.name: SMemories - auth
info.description: Email + password auth core (T-006): register, login, logout, /api/user/get-me, plus (T-007, T-048) verification code resend/verify, forgot/reset password. Run against an API started with SMEM_ENV=dev (the session cookie is not Secure there, so Newman's cookie jar sends it over http). Step 1 registers with locale vi (T-045: the stored locale is returned; the default en and the vi verification email are covered by the Go integration tests). Register is limited to 5 per hour per IP and each run makes 3 counted attempts (the register, the duplicate and, for the username steps, a second account), so a second run within the hour gets 429: run `make reset-limits` (the limiters live in Redis) or set SMEM_RATE_REGISTER_PER_HOUR higher. Forgot-password is limited to 5 per hour per IP and each run makes 2 counted calls, so a third run within the hour gets 429 (run `make reset-limits` to reset). Email one-time codes (T-048): the full flow uses the dev-only fixed code 123123 (`SMEM_DEV_FIXED_OTP`, default in `.env.example`; the API must run with it and SMEM_ENV=dev, otherwise the verify and reset steps fail). Wrong, malformed, locked (5 wrong attempts) and weak-password cases run here too. Code expiry (15 and 30 minutes), the real random codes, parallel guesses and the 503 when Redis is down are covered by the Go integration tests. Limits per run: 3 of 3 resends, about 10 of 20 verify attempts, 4 of 20 reset attempts per IP; two back-to-back runs fit. Google sign-in (T-011): the last folder needs the API started with the SMEM_GOOGLE_* variables (README, 'Google sign-in setup'); requests there do not follow redirects. Username (T-081, steps 37-55 of the full flow): default name, no-op, invalid/reserved/taken, the 7-day cooldown with Retry-After; the 20 failed attempts per hour limit and the 7-day clock edges run in the Go integration tests (they need a test clock).

item.name: Full flow

exec: // Folder scripts run before every request in the folder, so generate only before the first one: the whole flow then
// uses one consistent account, and every new run of the folder gets a fresh one (no collision with old data).
pm.collectionVariables.set('passwordNfd', 'Fake-Newman-pw-Việt-'.normalize('NFD') + n); // same password, decomposed (NFD): L-09 says login must accept it
pm.collectionVariables.set('newPassword', 'Fake-Newman-new-pw-' + n); // set by the reset step
pm.collectionVariables.set('fixedOtp', '123123'); // DEV-SHORTCUT(otp): SMEM_DEV_FIXED_OTP in .env.example; the API must run with it (SMEM_ENV=dev)
// T-081: names for the username steps (unique per run); uNameMixed is the same name in upper case (the API lower-cases it).

item.name: 1. Register (locale vi)

exec: pm.test("user object is exactly the 8 documented fields", () => { const u = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(Object.keys(u).sort()).to.eql(["created_at","display_name","email","email_verified","id","locale","username","username_next_change_at"]); pm.expect(u.id).to.match(/^[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{26}$/); pm.expect(u.email_verified).to.eql(false); pm.expect(u.locale).to.eql("vi"); pm.expect(u.created_at).to.be.a("number"); });
pm.test("no password or hash in the body", () => pm.expect(pm.response.text().toLowerCase()).to.not.match(/password|argon|hash/));

pm.test("session cookie flags", () => { const c = pm.response.headers.get("Set-Cookie") || ""; pm.expect(c).to.include("smem_session="); pm.expect(c).to.include("HttpOnly"); pm.expect(c).to.include("SameSite=Lax"); pm.expect(c).to.include("Path=/"); pm.expect(c).to.include("Max-Age=2592000"); });

pm.test("email and display name", () => { const u = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(u.email).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("email")); pm.expect(u.display_name).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("displayName")); });

exec: pm.test("lower-cased name, next change in about 7 days", () => { const u = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(u.username).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("uName")); const d = u.username_next_change_at - Date.now(); pm.expect(d).to.be.within(7 * 864e5 - 36e5, 7 * 864e5 + 36e5); pm.collectionVariables.set("uNext", u.username_next_change_at); });

Google sign-in
item.description: Needs the API started with SMEM_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, SMEM_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, SMEM_PUBLIC_BASE_URL and SMEM_OIDC_COOKIE_KEY (see the README); without them these routes are 404 and this folder fails. Only the steps that need no signed-in Google user: the redirect, the cookie, and the rejection paths. The happy paths, linking, the pre-hijacking defence and every ID-token check run against an in-process fake provider in the Go integration tests. Start needs to reach the provider's discovery document (https://accounts.google.com unless SMEM_GOOGLE_ISSUER says otherwise). Each callback clears smem_oidc, so every callback step has its own start.

item.name: 1. Start - redirect to the provider with PKCE, state and nonce

exec: pm.test("redirects to the provider (if this fails with /login?error=oidc_failed the provider could not be reached: check SMEM_GOOGLE_ISSUER and the network)", () => pm.expect(loc).to.match(/^https:\/\//));
const param = k => { const m = loc.match(new RegExp("[?&]" + k + "=([^&]*)")); return m ? decodeURIComponent(m[1].replace(/\+/g, " ")) : null; };
pm.test("smem_oidc cookie: HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, 10 minutes", () => { pm.expect(oc).to.include("HttpOnly"); pm.expect(oc).to.match(/SameSite=Lax/i); pm.expect(oc).to.match(/Max-Age=600/i); });

item.name: 2. Callback - provider denied (error param, valid cookie and state) - oidc_denied

exec: pm.test("no session cookie, smem_oidc cleared", () => { pm.expect(sc.some(v => v.startsWith("smem_session="))).to.be.false; pm.expect(sc.some(v => v.startsWith("smem_oidc=") && /Max-Age=0|Expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970/i.test(v))).to.be.true; });

pm.test("smem_oidc cookie: HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, 10 minutes", () => { pm.expect(oc).to.include("HttpOnly"); pm.expect(oc).to.match(/SameSite=Lax/i); pm.expect(oc).to.match(/Max-Age=600/i); });
